hero.headline: The Technology Stack for Agroecology.
hero.subheadline: We build the digital infrastructure that helps grassroots collectives scale. We manage the data complexity so you can focus on the soil, the farmers, and the community.
hero.placeholder: [IMAGE REQ: High-quality photograph of women farmers at the Kai Thota demo farm in Ragihalli, working the soil.]

manifesto.heading: Grassroots impact shouldn't die behind a desk.
manifesto.copy: Agricultural software is traditionally built for auditors, turning field workers into data-entry clerks. We build invisible, offline-first technology designed for the realities of climate-resilient farming, unpredictable yields, and community-driven logistics.

architecture.heading: The Architecture of Scale
architecture.tagline: Two complementary systems linking grassroots data collection to community food commerce.
architecture.fieldCopy: Voice-native, offline-first tools allowing women farmers to log daily inputs in local languages. We automate organic transition compliance without adding mental load to the grower.
architecture.fieldPlaceholder: [IMAGE REQ: Close-up of a farmer logging voice data on a mobile device in the field.]
architecture.marketCopy: A subscription storefront built for the physics of Community Supported Agriculture. We aggregate micro-yields into weekly subscriptions with full traceability back to the farm off Bannerghatta Road.
architecture.marketPlaceholder: [IMAGE REQ: Fresh, organic harvest aggregated for community distribution.]

pitch.heading: Built for Collectives. Funded for Scale.
pitch.copy: We provide the digital rails to keep climate-resilient agriculture alive and funded.
